newsitem.title: INDIA: India's Reliance confirms bonus meet.
newsitem.headline: India's Reliance confirms bonus meet.

text.p: The board of directors of Indian petrochemicals firm Reliance Industries Ltd will meet to consider a bonus issue of shares on June 26, a company spokesman confirmed on Thursday.
Earlier a source close to the company had told Reuters that the firm's board would meet for a bonus issue.
The company is also due to hold its annual shareholders meeting on that day. The spokesman said he did not know what time the board meeting would be held.
Reliance shares surged 14 rupees, or more than four percent, to 335 on the Bombay bourse on the news.
The company's shares have risen around 60 percent this year on the back of large capacity additions, increased profits and hopes of a bonus share issue.
